Issue #4203 reports that all file uploads fail with a "Malformed row" error on row 1 after moving to a new Windows accounting export tool. Searches and reads identified `src/ingest/parser.ts` as the file responsible for throwing this error via `errors.rowShape`.

input.body:
label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts

The new Windows accounting export tool likely produces files with CRLF line endings (\r\n), causing `lines[index]` to retain a trailing carriage return (`\r`) in each field. This mismatch causes `fields.length !== header.length`, triggering the `errors.rowShape` "Malformed row" error on row 1.
